feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 23 September 2026 6:19am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

North or NW 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later in morning or early afternoon, 3 or 4 in evening, before becoming Variable 2 or 3 for a time tonight. Settling South or SE 4 or 5 later in night.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, falling slight later today.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain at first, possibly heavy. but soon clearing this morning.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds for a time.


##Wind)##

South or SE 4 or 5, increasing South 5 or 6 in morning. Little change for the rest of the day, then veering West 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate, falling slight again later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
